summary: Find, evaluate, tailor for, and track job applications.

help:
Usage: jobs [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Find, evaluate, tailor for, and track job applications

Options:
  --profile <str>       Work for this account (its sign-in email). Default: the original account.
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  ready                        Open strong and possible roles; score is optional.
  show                         Posting detail: description, evaluation report, skill gap, legitimacy.
  scan                         Run a scan across the enabled sources and report its counters.
  screen                       Queue screening within the shared daily allowance.
  evaluate                     Run the evaluator agent over one posting and persist the report.
  tailor                       Generate a tailored resume and/or cover letter for one posting.
  apply                        Record an application against a posting.
  status                       Move an application to a new status and record the transition.
  track                        List applications, most recently moved first.
  followups                    Pending follow-ups, earliest due first.
  prep                         The interview brief for one application.
  stats                        Application funnel and posting-state counts.
  profile                      The candidate profile every agent prompt is built from.
  profile-edit                 Read the exact editable candidate requirements and their revision
  update-profile               Save owner-requested target roles, pay, location, or other candidate requirements
  cv-versions                  Inspect base CV versions before drafting or restoring one
  save-cv                      Activate a revised base CV after its exact text and facts were reviewed with the owner
  search                       Postings narrowed by work mode, employment type, company size and distance.
  session                      Start a weekly job-search session
  cv                           Read the reviewed CV before a posting assessment or document draft
  assess                       Save a sourced human or TUI posting assessment
  review-company               Record owner interest and sourced company culture findings
  record-board                 Record a verified official board or unsupported employer
  event-add                    Save a dated, sourced professional event
  events                       Review upcoming sourced events
  webinar-refresh              Refresh official public webinar sources now
  webinar-sources              Review official webinar feeds and this profile's follow choices
  webinar-follow               Follow or unfollow an official webinar source for this profile
  feedback                     Record a like, dislike, or mixed reaction to a role, company, or event
  feedback-queue               Review pending and clarified owner reactions
  feedback-claim               Atomically claim one pending reaction for review
  feedback-outcome             Record a sourced preference effect or clarification question
  feedback-answer              Record the owner's answer to a clarification question
  feedback-undo                Undo an applied soft preference after owner correction
  qualify-company              Save direct-employer, official careers, Florida eligibility (counts only for accounts living...
  company-qualification        Check an employer's current monitoring gate
  company-exception            Record a historical owner exception decision
  application-readiness        Check current preparation blockers and provenance before applying
  prepare-application          Save a sourced official JD and preparation notes
  set-preferences              Record the owner's company and culture priorities for future search sessions
  exclude-company              The owner does not want a company in the search
  coverage                     Review failed and unsupported employers and missed daily scans; --status for the others
  filters                      Inspect the live per-profile posting filters before changing eligibility
  set-filters                  Update live per-profile posting filters after reviewing their current values
  import-posting               Import a posting found on an unsupported official board with st web
  record-posting-source        Retain a complete verified official job description before a role assessment
  posting-source-history       Check retained source provenance after a posting or scanner refresh
  associate-posting            Link an imported posting to a researched employer after confirming identity
  correct-posting-company      Correct a posting attributed to the wrong employer after checking its source
  posting-company-corrections  Review the owner-audited company correction history for one posting
  supply-document              Save a TUI-written application document
  check-document               Before handing off a resume or cover letter: check the exact PDF, .docx or Markdown draft
  companies                    Tracked employers with their size, ownership, segments and nearest office.
help.ready:
Usage: jobs ready [OPTIONS]

  Open strong and possible roles; score is optional.

Options:
  --limit <int range>        [default: 10; 1<=x<=50]
  --min-score <float range>  Explicit scored-only filter  [0<=x<=5]
  --human                    Plain-text rendering
  --full                     Keep each role's whole fit assessment
  --help                     Show this message and exit.

  --employment <str>         full_time|part_time|contract|…; repeatable
  --employee-band <str>      startup_1_50|small_51_200|…; repeatable
  --segment <str>            healthcare|education|software_saas|msp|…; repeatable
  --channel-focus            Only IT or security vendors that sell through MSPs
  --max-distance <float>     Miles to the nearest researched office

  --offset <int range>       [default: 0; x>=0]
  --human                    Plain-text rendering
  --full                     Keep each row whole: fit reasoning, employer research, empty fields

usage.when: pick the next job worth acting on; start of any job-search working session
usage.why: strong and possible open postings, including unscored roles, with pending screening shown separately
precautions: read-only; applied postings are excluded, not ranked low; --human lists one line per posting; --full keeps each role's whole fit assessment

usage.when: read one posting in full before evaluating, tailoring, or deciding to skip it
usage.why: returns the job description together with its evaluation, skill gap and legitimacy flags
precautions: read-only; --no-description when only the verdict matters

usage.when: pull new postings from the tracked boards before triaging
usage.why: one run fetches, filters, de-duplicates and persists; counters say what was dropped and why
precautions: a full sweep takes minutes: narrow with --source/--company or use --background; adds postings, never touches applications

usage.when: triage the postings a scan left in `new` so the scored queues stop coming back empty
usage.why: one cheap call per posting sorts it into shortlisted or discarded; nothing else moves a posting out of `new`
precautions: one Aico call per posting, serially (50 take minutes); without --limit, JOBINATOR_SCREEN_DAILY_CAP
the nightly worker screens at 07:30 UTC; this is for a backlog

usage.when: score a posting for fit before spending a tailoring run on it
usage.why: persists the full report, subscores, legitimacy signal and skill gap against the posting
precautions: one Aico call, tens of seconds (free tier resets midnight Pacific); a rerun adds an evaluation, never replaces one

usage.when: produce the resume and cover letter for a posting you intend to submit
usage.why: writes both documents against this job description and stores them as versioned artifacts on the application
precautions: Aico calls, up to a minute per document; opens an application if the posting has none
a blocked fact check exits 1 listing the invented claims: fix the CV facts or regenerate, never hand-edit past it

usage.when: you have submitted an application and it needs to be on the record
usage.why: opens the application, dates it, and moves the posting out of the discovery queue
precautions: records state only, nothing goes to an employer; idempotent per posting; --no-submit for one not sent yet
examples: st jobs apply 41 -m 'referred by a former colleague'

usage.when: an application moved — a reply arrived, an interview was scheduled, a rejection landed
usage.why: writes a timeline transition as well as the new status, so funnel analytics stay truthful
precautions: records state only; nothing is sent to an employer
statuses: draft evaluated applied responded interview offer rejected discarded skip hired
examples: st jobs status 9 interview -m 'panel scheduled for the 12th'

usage.when: review what is in flight, or find the application id for a status change
precautions: read-only

usage.when: check which applications are owed a nudge
precautions: read-only; sending is manual — mark one sent from the UI after you send it

usage.when: an interview is scheduled and the candidate needs a brief for it
usage.why: reads the posting and the evaluation, then matches the story bank against what this interview will ask
precautions: --write spends an Aico call and takes about a minute; without it this only reads existing briefs
a story the bank does not hold is reported as a suggestion, never as prepared material

usage.when: report on the search: how many applications sit at each stage, and what the board holds
precautions: read-only; counts are current state, not a time series

usage.when: before writing anything on the candidate's behalf — targets, comp, authorization, allowed metrics
usage.why: the same candidate block the screener and tailor agents are given, so an agent-written draft cannot drift from theirs
precautions: read-only; cv_facts.allow_metrics is the only set of numbers permitted in generated documents

usage.when: read the exact editable candidate requirements and their revision
usage.why: prepare a specific profile change without overwriting unrelated fields
precautions: private candidate data; read-only

usage.when: save owner-requested target roles, pay, location, or other candidate requirements
usage.why: updates the canonical profile and refreshes role matching
precautions: read profile-edit first; changes replace only named fields; stale revisions are rejected

usage.when: inspect base CV versions before drafting or restoring one
usage.why: preserves the reviewed CV history
precautions: private candidate data; JSON includes full CV text

usage.when: activate a revised base CV after its exact text and facts were reviewed with the owner
usage.why: creates a version and refreshes the candidate's role matching
precautions: replaces the active CV; never set --verified before the owner reviews the exact draft

usage.when: answer a shaped question about the board — remote full-time at small companies, anything within 50 miles, channel vendors only
usage.why: `ready` ranks the whole queue by score; this is the same list narrowed by work mode, employment type, company size, segment and distance
precautions: read-only; page with --limit (up to 500) and --offset
--employee-band, --segment and --max-distance match only researched companies (unresearched is unknown, not excluded)
--max-distance drops remote roles (no distance): pass --remote-kind remote instead
examples: st jobs search --remote-kind remote --remote-kind hybrid --employment full_time --employee-band startup_1_50 --employee-band small_51_200

usage.when: start a weekly job-search session
usage.why: one snapshot of ready and pending roles, scans, failures, decisions, and events
precautions: read-only; no employer contact or notifications

usage.when: read the reviewed CV before a posting assessment or document draft
usage.why: returns the active CV, fact constraints, and revision identifiers
precautions: private candidate data; read-only

usage.when: save a sourced human or TUI posting assessment
usage.why: binds verdict and unknowns to the CV and posting revisions
precautions: evidence URLs and matching revisions are required

usage.when: record owner interest and sourced company culture findings
usage.why: keeps the owner's rating separate from inferred company fit
precautions: a positive or conflicting culture claim needs cited evidence

usage.when: record a verified official board or unsupported employer
usage.why: monitored boards enter Jobinator's collector with their official link evidence
precautions: monitored entries require an installed source and official evidence; pass company_id for an existing employer

usage.when: save a dated, sourced professional event
usage.why: feeds the upcoming events calendar with known cost or explicit unknown
precautions: no registration or notification is sent

usage.when: review upcoming sourced events
precautions: read-only; past events are excluded

usage.when: refresh official public webinar sources now
usage.why: uses the same serialized importer as the daily worker and reports source failures
precautions: does not register or notify anyone

usage.when: review official webinar feeds and this profile's follow choices
precautions: read-only

usage.when: follow or unfollow an official webinar source for this profile
usage.why: unfollow immediately hides that source's events and stops imports without deleting history
precautions: profile-specific; no registration or notification

usage.when: record a like, dislike, or mixed reaction to a role, company, or event
usage.why: creates a durable pending reaction for explicit review
precautions: nothing is sent to employers or organizers

usage.when: review pending and clarified owner reactions
precautions: read-only private feedback

usage.when: atomically claim one pending reaction for review
precautions: revision mismatch returns a conflict

usage.when: record a sourced preference effect or clarification question
precautions: only soft preferences apply; exclusions are proposals

usage.when: record the owner's answer to a clarification question
precautions: revision mismatch returns a conflict

usage.when: undo an applied soft preference after owner correction
precautions: preserves original reaction and reason

usage.when: save direct-employer, official careers, Florida eligibility (counts only for accounts living there), and PE control evidence
precautions: unresolved direct-employer or location evidence remains research-only; unknown PE control does not block monitoring

usage.when: check an employer's current monitoring gate
precautions: read-only

usage.when: record a historical owner exception decision
precautions: legacy exception records no longer change the monitoring gate

usage.when: check current preparation blockers and provenance before applying
precautions: read-only; does not submit an application

usage.when: save a sourced official JD and preparation notes
precautions: requires current CV, profile, and posting revisions; does not submit

usage.when: record the owner's company and culture priorities for future search sessions
usage.why: keeps explicit owner values separate from inferred company fit
precautions: does not contact employers or change the reviewed CV

usage.when: the owner does not want a company in the search
usage.why: stops monitoring, hides its current postings, and blocks future imports for this profile
precautions: preserves global postings and other profiles' choices

usage.when: review failed and unsupported employers and missed daily scans; --status for the others
usage.why: counts every employer by status and includes latest board health
precautions: read-only

usage.when: inspect the live per-profile posting filters before changing eligibility
precautions: read-only

usage.when: update live per-profile posting filters after reviewing their current values
usage.why: the existing filter API reapplies matching to saved postings
precautions: send only intended fields; arrays replace the complete current list

usage.when: import a posting found on an unsupported official board with st web
usage.why: stores a sourced URL and description in Jobinator for the normal review flow
precautions: the input URL must be the actual posting source

usage.when: retain a complete verified official job description before a role assessment
